result.topic_en: Thermodynamic calculation of heat dQ = U dv + V dt for an ideal gas, finding an integrating factor λ so that λ dQ is an exact differential, followed by a sketch of a Carnot-type cycle with heat reservoirs K_1, K_2 and heats Q_1, Q.
result.transcription:
1) $A Q = A U + W$
$dQ = U dv + V dt$ 	 $U = \frac{p}{A}$
2) $A\left(\frac{\partial U}{\partial t} - \frac{\partial V}{\partial v}\right) = \frac{\partial p}{\partial t}$
$\mu U = \frac{\partial p}{\partial t}$ 	 [-$\frac{\partial}{\partial}$-] $\mu = \frac{A \frac{\partial p}{\partial t}}{p} = \frac{A}{a+t}$
[-$A$-] $\frac{\partial U}{\partial t} - \frac{\partial V}{\partial v} - \frac{\mu}{A} U = 0$
$\lambda \frac{\partial U}{\partial t} - \frac{\partial V}{\partial v}\lambda + \frac{\partial \lambda}{\partial t} U = 0$ 	 $-\lambda \frac{\mu}{A} = \frac{\partial \lambda}{\partial t}$
$\frac{\partial \lambda U}{\partial t} - \frac{\partial \lambda V}{\partial v} = 0$
